description: This source file contains utility functions for performing basic arithmetic operations (addition and subtraction) within a Django project. It includes internal helper functions for input validation and type conversion, and publicly exposed functions for addition and subtraction that handle different input types (numbers or numeric strings).

methods.name: Number _to_number(value)

methods.name: Number add(a: Union[Number, str], b: Union[Number, str])
methods.description: Public function that returns the sum of two inputs, which can be numbers or numeric strings. It ensures proper type conversion and returns an int if both inputs are integers, or float otherwise.

methods.name: Number subtract(a: Union[Number, str], b: Union[Number, str])
methods.description: Public function that returns the difference of two inputs, which can be numbers or numeric strings. It ensures proper type conversion and returns an int if both inputs are integers, or float otherwise.
